name: Colorado AI Act (SB24-205)

use_case_categories: High-risk AI systems making consequential decisions about consumers
scope.description: Applies to developers and deployers of high-risk AI systems that make consequential decisions in education, employment, financial services, government services, healthcare, housing, insurance, and legal services.

requirements.obligation: Deployers must implement a risk management policy for high-risk AI systems
requirements.penalty: Enforcement by Colorado AG under Colorado Consumer Protection Act

requirements.obligation: Deployers must complete impact assessments for high-risk AI systems
Notify consumers when AI is used to make consequential decisions about them
Provide consumers opportunity to correct data and appeal AI-driven decisions
Developers must provide deployers with documentation about the AI system including known limitations and intended uses

ai_risk_tier: Maps to GAIF High for consequential decision systems

compliance_routing_rules: Route consequential decision queries through systems with impact assessment documentation
behavioral_contract_thresholds: Bias testing results must be documented and shared with deployers
disclosure_requirements: Consumer notification before consequential AI decision
Right to appeal and human review
